gaps: Every breath-one denominator was written as an estimate of the world's universe with a blind spot: a wall, a grammar, a product, a partition, a corpus, an overlap, a frequency table, a curve, a refusal. Pressing on Singletons' vote and Flattening curve showed that both bound the reach of the process that produced them and say nothing about members no process reaches; pressing on Two nets showed the estimate is only as good as the second net's freedom to catch a stranger. This produced the changed question for breath two: whose reach does each denominator measure, and can a universe be manufactured out of a remit, a readership, a planted sample, a day, or the proposer's own output.
accepted: Round wall: the universe is a cardinal fixed by an arithmetic or physical bound before any member is enumerated, so the enumerator counts against a number that has no members in it, as the sixty-four codons that four bases taken three at a time can spell, the four billion addresses of a thirty-two-bit space, the twenty amino acids of the genetic code, the games of chess bounded by a count of legal positions, the pigeonhole that says twenty-one socks in twenty drawers must double up somewhere; the carrier is the bound itself, a product of a base and an exponent or a constraint the world is believed to obey; it makes countable the maximum, and the fraction held is exact, since the numerator is the list and the denominator is a formula; it silently excludes whatever the bound's model did not admit, so the twenty amino acids were the whole universe until selenocysteine and pyrrolysine were read out of codons the table had marked as stops, and the address space counts unrouted blocks as members while the bound's model, that every address is a place, was never a fact; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count is round in some base and its members have no names, since a found universe is a roster and a bound is a number, and the enumerator who says a list is one thousandth complete against a wall has said only how big the wall is; analytical, with the codon and address bounds as observed cases; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which asks whether the list can name its universe and the fraction held, the case where the fraction is exact and the universe is empty of members; not Zwicky's box, where the cells are coordinates a member can be placed at, since here there are no cells, only a count.

Compiler's catalogue: the universe is whatever a generating grammar can produce, so the enumeration is complete by construction over the grammar's output and the enumerator counts members by deriving them, as a compiler's numbered diagnostics, each of which is a rule in the checker and none of which can be missing because an error the checker cannot name is not an error it emits, the names a chemical nomenclature can spell, the openings a move generator can reach to a given depth, the forms a paradigm table can decline, the combinatorial library synthesized from a fixed set of reagents and a fixed set of reactions; the carrier is the grammar, a rule set whose closure is the universe; it makes countable every well-formed member and the derivation that reaches it, so a member can be shown to be in or out by parsing; it silently excludes whatever the grammar cannot spell, and the exclusion is silent because the grammar does not say no, it says nothing, so the fault the checker has no rule for is not reported as unfound but is simply not a diagnostic, and the reaction the library's reagents cannot make is not a missing compound but a non-member; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that every member parses in one form and the list has no ungrammatical member, and a case brought from outside is answered with not a member rather than missed, so the enumerator who is told the list is complete should ask for one thing the grammar was built not to say; analytical, with the compiler's error codes and the codon table's reading frame as observed cases; adds to invariant-kinds, which holds what a transformation preserves, the universe that a rule set's closure defines; not Round wall, which gives a cardinal with no members, since here every member is derivable and named, and not Zwicky's box, where the universe is a product of chosen values and the member is a cell, since a grammar's output is not a product and its members are derivations.

Zwicky's box: the universe is the product of a few chosen dimensions with a few values each, so every combination is a cell, the cell count is the denominator, and the enumeration is the filling of cells, as the morphological box that multiplied the ways of making a jet engine into tens of thousands of cells, the two-by-two that gives a strategy meeting its four quadrants, the design-of-experiments grid, the periodic table read as period times group before any element is placed, and the meta-list pass of this atlas, which crosses each stated domain with the generative angle it under-serves to make list specifications by product; the carrier is the product, and the choice of dimensions is made before any member is placed; it makes countable the combinations, so a filled cell is a member, an empty cell is a named absence, and the fraction held is cells filled over cells; it silently excludes whatever does not decompose along the chosen dimensions, the engine that is not a value on any propulsion axis, the strategy that sits on a diagonal, the member that occupies two values at once and is forced into one, and the exclusion is silent because the product has a cell for every combination of what it thought of and no cell for what it did not; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count is a product of small integers and a member reads as its coordinates plus a case, small and red and fast and here is one, so an enumerator whose items can be reconstructed from the axis labels has enumerated the axes; analytical, with the morphological box and the two-by-two as observed cases; the empty cell's yield, Mendeleev's gallium, belongs to form-yields, and this map holds only the universe the product manufactures; not Filing classes, a partition imposed by an authority for filing whose cells are not coordinates and whose residual bin carries the misfits, since a product has no residual bin and the misfit is forced into a cell.

Filing classes: the universe is a partition somebody else made for filing, so the enumerator counts members per class and treats an empty class as a hole and a full class as saturation, as the patent classification under which every application must take a code, the disease codes under which every visit is billed, the library's decimal classes, the divisions of a prior catalogue used as lenses by this atlas's meta-list pass, which reads each of a founder's two hundred and thirty-six divisions as a kind of list worth making; the carrier is the partition and the filing rule that forces every member into exactly one class; it makes countable the fill per class and the empty classes, and it makes a novelty search possible, since a member's class says where its neighbours are filed; it silently excludes whatever the partition has no class for, and the exclusion is not silent in the usual way but pooled, since the partition keeps a residual bin, other, unspecified, miscellaneous, into which the misfits are filed and where they are counted but not distinguished, so the invention that crosses three classes takes one code by rule and the visit that fits no code takes the unspecified one; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is the share of the residual bin, since a partition that fits the world has a small other and a partition that was the filer's has the largest class as other, and a second tell is that the empty classes are the founder's, not the world's, so an empty division says the founder imagined a kind of list and the atlas has not made one, which is not the same as the kind being possible; observed, with the patent office's classes and the disease codes' unspecified codes as cases; not Zwicky's box, where the cells are coordinates and the misfit is forced into a cell, since here the cells are classes and the misfit is filed as other, and not Induced cells, where the partition is read off the members, since here it was written before them by a hand that never saw this list.

Parish register: the universe is a corpus that an institution keeps for its own purposes, so the enumerator counts what entered the corpus and calls that the population, as the court docket that holds every dispute that was filed and none that was settled on the steps, the dictionary's reading programme, which attested a word only from the books its volunteers happened to read and whose editor had to appeal in print for readers of the books nobody read, the parish register of baptisms as the count of births, the patent office's filings as the count of inventions while the trade secret is by design not in it, the address file from which a census is taken and against which its coverage is measured; the carrier is the institution's intake rule, the condition under which a thing enters the corpus, together with the corpus's own list; it makes countable whatever met the intake rule, and where the corpus is a frame and the enumeration a sample, it makes the sample scalable, so a count of a few thousand can stand for a population by the frame's size; it silently excludes whatever the intake rule never admitted, the dispute that never filed, the word never printed, the household with no address in the file, and the exclusion is silent because the corpus does not record the things that did not enter it, so a frame with holes under-counts by construction and the holes are visible only from outside the frame; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count moves when the intake rule moves and not when the world does, so a court that raises its filing fee reduces disputes, a reading programme that adds a genre discovers a vocabulary, and a frame that adds mobile numbers finds a population that was there all along; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Enough bodies, where the missing witness is a count of chances too small for the rare case, the case where the chances were never counted because the rare case never entered the register; not Bar date, where the intake closes on a day, since here it closes on a kind.

Borrowed checklist: the universe is a finished list made for another purpose, applied to a new object as the set of things that could be present, so the enumerator counts which members of the borrowed list the object has and reports coverage against the borrowed length, as the coverage audit this atlas prints, which asks the reader to label every member of a chosen map present, ruled out, or unlabeled against a plan and to finish with zero unlabeled or the word partial, the surgical checklist read over every operation, the differential diagnosis worked through for every presentation, the pre-flight card, the taxonomy of failure modes ticked off in a review; the carrier is the borrowed list and the rule that every member must take a label; it makes countable the object's coverage of the list, which turns a feeling of thoroughness into a labelled denominator and forces the enumerator to say where each mechanism sits or why it cannot; it silently excludes the object's own mechanism that the borrowed list has no member for, since the audit can label only what the list names, and zero unlabeled reads as complete when the plan's real risk was never on the card, and the exclusion is silent because the audit's residual, partial, measures the auditor's indecision about the listed members and not the list's reach; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count can never exceed the borrowed list's length and the audit never finds a member, only labels, so an enumerator who has never once had to add a line to the card has borrowed its universe from someone who never saw the object; observed; not Parish register, where the corpus was kept by an institution that admits members by an intake rule, since here the list was finished elsewhere and admits nothing, and not Filing classes, where every member takes a class and the misfit is filed as other, since here the misfit is not filed at all.

Priced adversary: the universe is estimated by paying an adversary to find members, so the denominator is whatever a motivated outsider can find at the price offered, as the bug bounty whose payouts define which vulnerabilities exist for the vendor, the red team engaged for a fixed number of days, the opposing counsel whose discovery requests enumerate the documents the other side would rather were not documents, the competitor's teardown, the prize offered for a counterexample; the carrier is the adversary's reach, bounded by the price and the term, and the adversary's interest, which is the opposite of the enumerator's and so is not correlated with the enumerator's blind spots in the way a second friendly net is; it makes countable the members within a budget, and it makes the enumerator's own list checkable by someone who wants it to be wrong, which no friendly net supplies; it silently excludes whatever is worth more to the adversary kept than sold, so the vulnerability that a broker pays more for than the vendor does is not in the vendor's universe, the document that would end the case is the one the adversary finds and the enumerator never sees, and the exclusion is silent because the adversary reports only what it sells; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count rises when the price rises, since a found universe does not move with the bounty, and a second tell is that the adversary's finds cluster at the price's margin, the cheap members found and the dear ones held; observed, with the bounty and the broker's premium as cases; adds to witness-architectures' Mine for silence, which removes the dominant signal to hear the faint one, the net that hears the faint member because it is paid to; not Two nets, whose second net is independent and unpaid and whose arithmetic needs the overlap, since here the overlap is not computed and the adversary's edge is a price.

Two nets: the universe is estimated from the overlap of two enumerations made independently, so the members neither net caught are counted from how many the second net caught that the first had, as the marked fish recaptured, the census whose undercount is estimated from a second survey of the same blocks by a separate team, the two proofreaders whose shared and unshared catches give the number of misprints neither found, the two literature searches whose overlap says how much of the field either reached; the carrier is a second net that must be independent of the first, and the arithmetic that turns the overlap into a total; it makes countable the members nobody has seen, as a number with an interval, which no single enumeration can give, and it makes the first net's recall a measurable quantity rather than a feeling; it silently excludes whatever both nets miss for the same reason, since the arithmetic assumes that being caught by one net says nothing about being caught by the other, and where the nets are correlated, two counts made from the same records, two reviewers trained in the same school, two survey teams who both cannot enter the same buildings, the members missed by both are counted as nonexistent and the estimate is confident about exactly the people the census cannot find; the tell that the denominator was manufactured rather than found is that the estimated missing have no names, only a count, and a second tell is an overlap too high for the nets' reach, since two nets drawn from one source agree on the world as it looked from that source; observed, with the fish, the census's second survey, and the proofreaders as cases; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty the only mechanism on this map that measures the fraction held without a universe being given, at the price of an independence nobody can verify from inside either net; not Salted proof, where the second sample is planted by the enumerator and can only estimate members of the planted kind, since here the second net is another enumerator's and can catch strangers, and not Priced adversary, whose second net is bought and stops at a price.

Shuffled twin: the universe is what chance alone would enumerate, so the denominator is a distribution of lists made by shuffling and the enumerator counts its excess over the shuffle, as the permutation test that scores an ordering against a thousand random orderings of the same items, the placebo arm that gives the treated arm its denominator of recoveries that would have happened anyway, the null model in ecology under which species are dealt to islands at random and the observed co-occurrence is scored against the deal, the seriation pass of this atlas, which measures how strongly one hidden dimension runs through a list as the smoothness gained over a random order of the same members; the carrier is a generator of randomized twins of the enumeration and a statistic compared across them; it makes countable the excess, the part of the enumeration that chance would not have produced, as a fraction of the shuffles it beats; it silently excludes whatever chance also has, since a member or a structure that a random twin would also show is scored as nothing found even when it is real, the ordering that is both true and easy, the co-occurrence that is both caused and common; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that it is a distribution and not a set, its members are draws and have no names, and the answer is a rank among twins rather than a count of members, so an enumerator who reports a list as significant has counted against nobody's universe but a dealer's; analytical, with the permutation test and the null model as observed cases; adds to witness-architectures' Untouched twin, where a difference is recordable only as a difference from a manufactured second case, the case where the second case is manufactured by shuffling the first; not Two nets, whose second net is another enumerator and catches strangers, since a shuffle catches only what was already in the bag.

Flattening curve: the universe is the asymptote of a curve of new members against effort, so the enumerator plots how many members each unit of effort yielded and reads the limit the curve is bending toward, as the collector's curve of species against samples, the rarefaction curve that lets two surveys of different effort be compared at the same effort, the reliability-growth curve of faults found against test hours from which a release is predicted, the trawl that stops when the last ten hauls brought nothing new; the carrier is the effort log, the order in which members appeared, and a curve fitted to it; it makes countable the total as a limit and the effort needed to reach a fraction of it, so an enumerator can be told that another hundred hours will yield three members, which is a stopping rule with a price on it; it silently excludes whatever the effort's reach never touches, since the curve flattens on the reachable and an asymptote is the reachable universe, so members behind a wall the method never crosses, the nocturnal species in a daytime survey, the fault in the path no test exercises, look like nonexistence; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the asymptote moves when the method changes and not only when the effort grows, a new trap or a night survey raising the limit itself rather than climbing the same curve faster, so a found universe would sit still under a change of method and a manufactured one jumps; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb flags a plateau when the keep rate falls below a fixed fraction, which is one point on this curve read without the curve, so the flag cannot say whether the limit was reached or the method's edge was; not Singletons' vote, which needs no order and names no limit, since here the order is the evidence and the limit is the output.

Singletons' vote: the universe is estimated from the enumeration's own rediscovery statistics, so the share of members seen exactly once estimates the mass still unseen, and the enumerator's own frequency table is the whole evidence, as the estimator worked out at Bletchley from the frequency of ciphers seen once and published after the war, the ecologist's richness estimates built from singletons and doubletons, the estimate of the words a poet knew but never used from how many he used once, the search whose repeated hits on the same pages say the index is nearly exhausted; the carrier is the count of members seen once against the count of sightings, which any enumeration that records duplicates can produce; it makes countable the unseen as a share of the next sighting, so an enumerator can say how likely the next member is to be new without any universe being given; it silently excludes whatever the process never reaches at all, since a member with zero reach contributes nothing to the singletons and the estimator is a statement about the sampling process and not about the world, so a net that cannot reach the deep water estimates the lake as nearly counted; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the estimate moves when the same process is rerun and not when a different eye looks, and a second tell is an all-singleton list, every member seen once, which the estimator reads as an ocean unseen, so a generator that never repeats itself will always be told it has barely begun; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb's gate drops re-proposed members as duplicates and records the drops as residue, which is the rediscovery count this estimator would read, and the climb reads a keep rate instead, so the number that could have said how much of its own reach the list had covered is thrown away as failure; not Flattening curve, which needs the order in which members arrived and estimates a limit with an effort to reach it, since here one unordered bag with its duplicates counted is enough and no limit is named.

Induced cells: the enumerator reads a typology off the members it already has and treats the typology's cells as the universe, so the underpopulated cell becomes a number and the empty cell becomes the gradient, as the strong-tier typology step of this atlas's climb, which induces the most revealing typology the items support, names missing and underpopulated types, and hands them to a cheap-tier grower as targets, the taxonomist who reads a genus off the specimens on the table and then collects toward its thin branches, the reviewer who sorts a literature into schools and calls the smallest school understudied; the carrier is the induced typology, whose dimensions were read from the pile rather than chosen before it; it makes countable the fill of each induced cell, so growth has a direction and the direction can be measured; it silently excludes whatever the pile had no member of, since a typology induced from members has cells only where members were, and a member that would found a new cell looks from inside the typology like noise or like a poor fit for an existing cell, so the gradient points inward toward filling what the typology already has and the denominator grows by refinement of its own cells and never by a cell the pile could not have suggested; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the missing types are named as negations or interpolations of the present ones, the non-X, the between X and Y, and that the induced universe is never larger than the pile could imply, so an enumerator whose gap list reads as the complement of its type list is reading its own list back; observed in this atlas's climb, analytical in the general form; adds to list-excellences' Latent typology, which prizes the interior order that surfaces when a list completes, the cost of surfacing it before the list is complete and then growing toward it; not Zwicky's box, whose axes were chosen before any member and can therefore have a cell for a stranger, since here the axes are the members' and a stranger has no cell.

Open fence: the enumerator declares that there is no universe and refuses the denominator, so every omission is converted from an error into a non-event and the fraction held becomes an unaskable question, as the field guide to the common birds of a region, whose title excuses every rarity it lacks, the dictionary's preface that disclaims completeness, the survey report's out of scope, and the coverage line of this atlas, open with no claim of exhaustiveness, which forty-one of its forty-seven map records carry as the identical sentence; the carrier is a declared refusal, a fence with one side; it makes nothing countable, and that is its function, since it makes the list's omissions unfalsifiable and lets the list be judged on what it holds; it silently excludes the reader's ability to know when to stop searching, and it excludes the missing from being missed, so a member that was never found and a member that was found and cut look the same from outside the fence; the tell that the refusal was manufactured rather than judged is that it is the same sentence on every list regardless of the list, since a refusal that was a judgment about this universe would differ from list to list in what it refused, and a rule stamping the same words on forty-one records is a rule reading itself back as a finding about each; observed; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, which prizes the stated refusal as an act, the mechanism by which the act is counterfeited, and to Denominator honesty the case where honesty is declined identically everywhere; not Round wall, which gives a number with no members, since here there is neither number nor members, only a fence, and the two are the endpoints of this map's walk.

residue.item: Enumerator's memory: the expert who has seen it all, the universe as what one enumerator can recall having seen.
residue.why: Rejected: the universe equals the list and the fraction is always one, which is a stall's material and not a denominator's carrier; enumeration-stalls holds the enumerator's own memory as what a stall is made of, and Own proposals holds the honest version, where the enumerator's output is the denominator and says so.

residue.item: Sampling frame: the address file or phone book from which a survey is drawn and scaled.
residue.why: Merged into Parish register as its sampled form; the frame is a corpus kept by an institution for another purpose, the scaling adds a numerator and no new carrier, and the coverage error is the same hole seen from outside.

residue.item: Count bound: the thirteen-to-eighteen work bound that reads as a universe when the list reaches it.
residue.why: Rejected and kept as a boundary case: the bound fixes the unit of the enumeration and not the universe, which is item-grains' territory; the tempting confusion, eighteen so we are done, is Own proposals read against a ceiling and adds no carrier.

residue.item: Known-unknowns list: the enumerator's own list of what it has not enumerated as the denominator.
residue.why: Merged into Open fence as the refusal that names what it refuses; a per-list refusal that lists its own holes is the honest form the item describes, and the mechanism is the same fence with writing on it.

residue.item: Correlated nets: two enumerators who miss the same members for the same reason.
residue.why: Held inside Two nets as its stated blind spot rather than admitted as a member, since the correlation is not a way of obtaining a universe but the way the overlap estimator lies; the second breath asks whether a second net can be made to miss differently on purpose.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real enumeration runs several of these at once, a corpus sampled under a bound, plotted as a curve, checked by a paid adversary, and refused at the end, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind, which is itself Open fence and is said here per list rather than by rule.

The seriation is an itinerary of whose reach the denominator measures, not a ranking of accuracy or honesty; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, degenerate closure, and passages they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the codon table's reread stops, the morphological box, the dictionary's reading programme, the census's second survey, the estimator from Bletchley, seeded faults, the bar date, the appellate record, this atlas's typology step, keep rate, coverage line, audit frame, and repair brief) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; estimator theory, court procedure, and survey practice vary, and nothing here is statistical or legal advice.

Universes that were given are out: the roster against which attendance is counted, the finite set handed to a checker, the population defined by the question; and the yield of an empty cell, Mendeleev's gallium, is form-yields', since this map holds only the universe the cell count manufactures. The count bound on a list is item-grains', since it fixes the unit and not the universe. The stall that feels like exhaustion is enumeration-stalls'; this map holds what the enumerator counts against, and Flattening curve and Own proposals are on the fence, since their asymptote and their fraction of one are what a stall is read from.

Neighbouring lists: list-excellences' Denominator honesty judges whether a finished list can name its universe and the fraction held, where this map holds the mechanisms by which a universe is obtained and the fraction can be false; witness-architectures holds what must exist before a difference can leave a trace, and Enough bodies, Untouched twin, Mine for silence, and Trigger's blind spot are its nearest members, each cited where a denominator is the same instrument seen as a universe.

gaps: The changed question yielded denominators that are somebody's reach rather than the world's: a day that defines the late out (Bar date), a second net forbidden by remit to add (Muzzled net), a readership that files itself (Letters after printing), a planted sample that can only be its own kind (Salted proof), and the proposer's own output, which reads one when the proposer stops (Own proposals), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed a denominator was about the subject. The seriation's axis came from this: Parish register and Bar date are the hinge where the universe becomes an intake, the four second nets are ordered by how free the second enumerator is, Two nets → Muzzled net is the adjacency where one remit turns an estimator into a mirror, and the walk ends at Own proposals → Open fence, where the same pipeline's fraction of one and its stamped refusal say the opposite thing about one map.
accepted: Bar date: the universe is closed by a day, so whatever has not appeared by the date is defined out and the count becomes exact by fiat, as the bankruptcy court's bar date after which an unfiled claim is not a claim, the census day on which the population is whoever was here that night, the dictionary's cutoff after which a word is not in this edition, the species list as of the year of publication, the freeze after which a bug is a feature request; the carrier is the date and the rule that late members are non-members; it makes countable a final population, and it makes the fraction held equal to one by construction, since the numerator and the denominator are both whoever showed up, so the count can be audited, sued over, and closed; it silently excludes the late and the unmatured, the creditor who did not know, the word coined the week after, the species not yet described, and the exclusion is silent because the date does not record what it shut out, so a universe closed on a day looks complete forever and its omissions arrive as the next edition's additions and are read as growth rather than as the old edition's holes; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is a date on it, since a universe that is found does not have an as-of and a universe with an as-of was made by whoever set it, and a second tell is the fraction reading exactly one, which no found universe yields; observed; adds to option-expiries' Bar date in the newspaper, which holds the claimant's option dying on a docket the claimant did not read, the other side of the same order, the estate's universe of creditors made countable by the same day; not Parish register, where the intake closes on a kind and stays open in time, since here it closes on a day and stays open in kind.

Muzzled net: a second enumerator is engaged whose remit forbids adding members, so its zero additions are read as the first enumerator's completeness and the universe is manufactured by a rule about what the second enumerator may say, as the repair pass of this atlas, whose brief says to apply every repair and cut the critic justified and to add no items of its own, and whose critic brief gives the fresh-context critic three decisions per item, keep, repair, or cut, and no decision that adds, so the only independent net the pipeline has is wired to return repairs and cuts and never a member, its one door to a new member, a verdict of return for another breath, hands the net back to the first enumerator, and the record it produces reads as reviewed and whole, the appellate court that may not take new evidence and so finds the record complete because the record is by rule all there is, the auditor who may test only the sample provided, the copy-editor whose remit is to strike and not to write, the second reader on a proof who is told to check the marks and not to read; the carrier is the second enumerator's remit, a rule that fixes what its catch can be; it makes countable the first list's errors of commission, since the muzzled net can still cut and repair, and it makes the first list look reviewed; it silently excludes every error of omission, which is the whole class a second net is engaged to find, and the exclusion is silent because a net that catches nothing and a net that may catch nothing report the same zero; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the second enumerator's output is entirely repairs and cuts across every list it reviewed, a distribution set by the remit rather than by the lists, and that no review in the record ever added a line, so an enumerator who wants to know whether a review was a net should look for one addition anywhere in its history; observed in this atlas's repair pass and in the appellate record, analytical in the general form; adds to witness-architectures' Trigger's blind spot, where the instrument is built not to see, the net built not to catch; not Two nets, whose second net is free and whose overlap is computed, since here the overlap is fixed at the whole first list by the remit and the arithmetic returns the first list as the universe.

Letters after printing: the universe is obtained by publishing the list and counting the corrections, so the omitted announce themselves and the readership becomes the denominator, as the dictionary whose readers write in with the word it lacks, the field guide's second edition made from the first edition's letters, the census campaign that asks whoever was not counted to say so, the bug tracker after release, the errata slip, the atlas that learns its holes from the person who looked for their county; the carrier is circulation, the readers who look for themselves in the list and find themselves absent, and a channel that brings the absence back; it makes countable the omissions that have an owner who reads, and it counts them at almost no cost to the enumerator, since the world does the second enumeration; it silently excludes the omissions with no constituency, the word of a language with no readers, the harm with no survivor, the species with no collector, the member whose interest is in staying uncounted, and the exclusion is silent because the correction channel reports only what someone wanted corrected, so a list read by nobody has no omissions and is complete; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count of corrections tracks the circulation and the readers' register rather than the list's completeness, a widely read list of a small subject drawing more letters than a rarely read list of a large one, so an enumerator who reports few corrections has reported few readers; observed; adds to passages-between-levels' Scatter as reading the case where the scatter is the readership and what is read is the list's holes; not Parish register, whose corpus is kept by an institution's intake and grows by filing, since here the list's own publication is the intake and the members file themselves, and not Priced adversary, since the readers are unpaid and interested in being counted rather than in the list being wrong.

Salted proof: the universe is estimated by planting known members and counting how many the enumeration recovers, so the recovered fraction of the plants is taken as the recovered fraction of the whole, as the seeded faults planted in a program before testing to estimate the faults remaining from the share of seeds the tests caught, the marked bills slipped into a cash count, the decoy planted for a search exercise, the spike-in of a known sequence at a known quantity into a sample so that the unknown quantities can be read against it, the answer key's known items mixed among the test's unknown ones; the carrier is the seeds, whose count the enumerator knows, and the ratio of seeds found to seeds planted; it makes countable the enumeration's recall on members like the seeds, and from it the total of such members, without a second independent enumerator and without waiting for a curve to flatten; it silently excludes whatever is unlike the seeds, since the seeder can plant only faults of the kind the seeder can imagine, and the faults the tests miss are the ones nobody imagined, so the estimate is the recall on the imaginable and the tell of its silence is that the seeded faults are found at a higher rate than the real ones every time the two can be compared; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that it moves with the choice of seeds and not with the world, a different seeder giving a different remaining count on the same program; observed, with seeded faults and the spike-in as cases; adds to witness-architectures' Untouched twin the second case manufactured by planting rather than by withholding treatment; not Two nets, whose second net is another enumerator and can catch strangers, since a seed is planted by the first enumerator and can only be its own kind, and not Shuffled twin, where what is planted is randomness and nothing is recovered, only ranked.

Own proposals: the universe is the enumerator's own output, so the fraction reported is what a judge kept over what the enumerator proposed, and the denominator was manufactured by the same hand whose work it measures, as this atlas's ledger, whose keep rate is items kept over candidates proposed, so it measures the gate's severity against the proposer's habits and says nothing about the subject's reach, and whose repair breath, forbidden to add items, reports a keep rate of one across every map because the proposer proposed nothing new and the rule that forbade it reads back as a finding, the journal's acceptance rate, whose denominator is the submissions and which therefore measures the submitters' expectations of the journal as much as the journal's standard, the search engine's precision without its recall, the hiring funnel's offer rate; the carrier is the proposer's own candidate list, taken as the population; it makes countable the judge's acceptance, which is a real quantity about the judge and the proposer together; it silently excludes everything not proposed, which is the whole of what a denominator was wanted for, and the exclusion is silent because a fraction looks like coverage, so a keep rate of one reads as a map that has arrived rather than as a proposer that has stopped; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the fraction rises when the proposer proposes less and reaches one when it proposes nothing, since a found universe would make the fraction fall as the proposer went quiet, so any coverage figure that improves under silence has the proposer's output in its denominator; observed; adds to importance-detectors' Fudged figure the shape a coverage figure takes when its denominator is the reporter's own count; not Singletons' vote, which also uses only the enumerator's own output but reads the duplicates and estimates the unseen, since here the duplicates are dropped and nothing unseen is estimated.

residue.item: Bounty with a broker: the vulnerability worth more kept than sold.
residue.why: Merged into Priced adversary as its stated exclusion; the broker's premium is the price at which the adversary's universe ends and not a second mechanism.

residue.item: Reader's exhausted expectation: the audience that stops proposing and whose silence is read as the universe's edge.
residue.why: Rejected: it is the readers' saturation as a stall, which is enumeration-stalls' territory; the denominator side of it, the readership that files itself, is Letters after printing, and the case where the readers' exhaustion is mistaken for the register's is that loop's second edge.

residue.item: Stranger's grammar: a second enumerator from another domain whose list is made under a different grammar so that its misses are uncorrelated by construction.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: it would sit between Two nets and Priced adversary as a second net chosen for the independence of its silence rather than for its reach, and the near opening's second run, authors from two model families, is its first experiment; held until a case shows that a different grammar misses differently rather than merely elsewhere.

residue.item: Verdict menu as denominator: the critic's four verdicts as the universe of what a review can say.
residue.why: Rejected: the menu fixes what crosses between passes and where the judgment sits, which is composition-yields' case, and this map holds only the muzzle that fixes whether the second net may add, which is one rule and not a menu.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real enumeration runs several of these at once, a corpus sampled under a bound, plotted as a curve, checked by a paid adversary, and refused at the end, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind, which is itself Open fence and is said here per list rather than by rule.

The seriation is an itinerary of whose reach the denominator measures, not a ranking of accuracy or honesty; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, degenerate closure, and passages they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the codon table's reread stops, the morphological box, the dictionary's reading programme, the census's second survey, the estimator from Bletchley, seeded faults, the bar date, the appellate record, this atlas's typology step, keep rate, coverage line, audit frame, and repair brief) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; estimator theory, court procedure, and survey practice vary, and nothing here is statistical or legal advice.

Universes that were given are out: the roster against which attendance is counted, the finite set handed to a checker, the population defined by the question; and the yield of an empty cell, Mendeleev's gallium, is form-yields', since this map holds only the universe the cell count manufactures. The count bound on a list is item-grains', since it fixes the unit and not the universe. The stall that feels like exhaustion is enumeration-stalls'; this map holds what the enumerator counts against, and Flattening curve and Own proposals are on the fence, since their asymptote and their fraction of one are what a stall is read from.

Neighbouring lists: list-excellences' Denominator honesty judges whether a finished list can name its universe and the fraction held, where this map holds the mechanisms by which a universe is obtained and the fraction can be false; witness-architectures holds what must exist before a difference can leave a trace, and Enough bodies, Untouched twin, Mine for silence, and Trigger's blind spot are its nearest members, each cited where a denominator is the same instrument seen as a universe.

neighbors.left: Singletons' vote: the universe is estimated from the enumeration's own rediscovery statistics, so the share of members seen exactly once estimates the mass still unseen, and the enumerator's own frequency table is the whole evidence, as the estimator worked out at Bletchley from how many things had been seen exactly once and published after the war, the ecologist's richness estimates built from singletons and doubletons, the estimate of the words a poet knew but never used from how many he used once, the search whose repeated hits on the same pages say the index is nearly exhausted; the carrier is the count of members seen once against the count of sightings, which any enumeration that records duplicates can produce; it makes countable the unseen as a share of the next sighting, so an enumerator can say how likely the next member is to be new without any universe being given; it silently excludes whatever the process never reaches at all, since a member with zero reach contributes nothing to the singletons and the estimator is a statement about the sampling process and not about the world, so a net that cannot reach the deep water estimates the lake as nearly counted; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the estimate moves when the same process is rerun and not when a different eye looks, and a second tell is an all-singleton list, every member seen once, which the estimator reads as an ocean unseen, so a generator that never repeats itself will always be told it has barely begun; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb's gate drops re-proposed members as duplicates and records the drops as residue, which is the rediscovery count this estimator would read, and the climb reads a keep rate instead, so the number that could have said how much of its own reach the list had covered is thrown away as failure; not Flattening curve, which needs the order in which members arrived and estimates a limit with an effort to reach it, since here one unordered bag with its duplicates counted is enough and no limit is named.
neighbors.right: Flattening curve: the universe is the asymptote of a curve of new members against effort, so the enumerator plots how many members each unit of effort yielded and reads the limit the curve is bending toward, as the collector's curve of species against samples, the rarefaction curve that lets two surveys of different effort be compared at the same effort, the reliability-growth curve of faults found against test hours from which a release is predicted, the trawl that stops when the last ten hauls brought nothing new; the carrier is the effort log, the order in which members appeared, and a curve fitted to it; it makes countable the total as a limit and the effort needed to reach a fraction of it, so an enumerator can be told that another hundred hours will yield three members, which is a stopping rule with a price on it; it silently excludes whatever the effort's reach never touches, since the curve flattens on the reachable and an asymptote is the reachable universe, so members behind a wall the method never crosses, the nocturnal species in a daytime survey, the fault in the path no test exercises, look like nonexistence; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the asymptote moves when the method changes and not only when the effort grows, a new trap or a night survey raising the limit itself rather than climbing the same curve faster, so a found universe would sit still under a change of method and a manufactured one jumps; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb flags a plateau when the keep rate falls below a fixed fraction, which is one point on this curve read without the curve, so the flag cannot say whether the limit was reached or the method's edge was; not Singletons' vote, which needs no order and names no limit, since here the order is the evidence and the limit is the output.
neighbors.separating_case: Two surveyors have counted the same marsh. One kept a bag of every bird seen with a tally mark per sighting and no dates; the other kept a diary of which bird was first seen on which day. The first can say what share of the next sighting will be a new species, from the share of species seen once, and cannot say how many species there are or how many more days it would take; the second can say the curve is bending toward some number and that ten more days will add two, and cannot say it from an unordered bag. Both are reading the same net, and neither can see the rail that only calls at night; the surveyor who confuses them asks the tally for a total it cannot give, or throws away the diary because the bag seemed enough, and the tell is whether the estimate has an effort on it.

checks.boundary_case: The tempting nonmember is the given universe, the class roster against which attendance is counted, the set handed to a checker, the population the question already named: found, not manufactured, and out by the declared type. The second tempting nonmember is the empty cell that yields a member, Mendeleev's gallium, which is form-yields' and is out because what it produces is a member and not a universe; Zwicky's box is in on that fence because the box's cell count is a denominator whether or not any cell yields. The third is the count bound, thirteen to eighteen, which fixes the unit and not the universe and is item-grains'. Own proposals sits on the fence with Singletons' vote, since both take the enumerator's own output as evidence, and is in because it estimates nothing unseen and reports a fraction that reads one when the proposer stops, which is a universe manufactured from the proposer's silence.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork at Induced cells reached by two doors, Zwicky's box when the product's axes are read off the members instead of chosen first, and Filing classes when the partition's residual bin outgrows its classes, so an induced typology is where both a product and a partition end up when the world does not decompose along them, and it inherits the silence of whichever door it came through, a stranger with no cell or a misfit never filed. It shows a loop, Parish register → Letters after printing → Parish register, in which a published register gains a second intake from its readers and the next edition's silence is read as completeness when it is the readers' exhaustion, so a list read by nobody is complete. It shows a degenerate closure at Two nets → Muzzled net, where a second net forbidden to add returns the first list as the universe and the pipeline that meant to measure omission measures commission, which the walk conceals because the two sit side by side as second nets and differ only in a remit. It shows a passage at Singletons' vote → Flattening curve that adds an effort and a stopping price and no reach, so two estimators can agree on a universe that was the net's. And it shows a passage at Own proposals → Open fence, where a fraction manufactured from the proposer's own output and a refusal stamped by rule are the same pipeline's two lines about one map, saying the opposite thing.
checks.target_preserved: A self-read, not an independent judgment; the fresh-context critic's review is pending. Each item names a distinct carrier, what it makes countable, what it silently excludes, and the tell of manufacture, and the strange members (a universe with no members in it, a second net forbidden to catch, a readership as a denominator, a fraction that reads one because the proposer went quiet, a fence stamped identically on forty-one records) stand as mechanisms with cases and not as advice about coverage.

next_crossfield_opening: Nets that miss differently on purpose: connect Two nets, Muzzled net, and Priced adversary with witness-architectures' Room for strangers and ask whether a second enumerator can be chosen for the independence of its silence rather than the size of its catch, so that the overlap estimator's one unverifiable assumption becomes a design choice, a second author from another grammar, another model family, another domain's field guide, whose misses are shown to be elsewhere and not merely fewer; if that holds, an atlas could carry, per map, a manufactured denominator whose manufacture is declared and whose blind spot is named, which is the denominator honesty list-excellences asks for and no list in the catalog has yet had.

gaps: Own proposals, the terminal item and the source of the last edge and passage, asserted as observed that the repair breath reports a keep rate of one across every map because the rule forbidding additions reads back as a finding; the ledgers show three of forty-four at 0.94 where the critic cut, so the rule manufactures a ceiling of one, not a value, and the map had in its own observed case read the rule back as the number, the failure the item describes. Structurally, Round wall and Compiler's catalogue shared the codon table as their leading case and Round wall's tell (members with no names) failed on three of its five cases, so the opening pair could not be separated by the author's own criterion until Round wall was restated as a bound computed without running a generator.
accepted: Round wall: the universe is a cardinal fixed by an arithmetic or physical bound computed without running any generator, so the enumerator counts against a number that has no members on the table, as the ten-to-the-hundred-and-twentieth games of chess estimated from a branching factor and a game length that nobody has played out, the pigeonhole that says twenty-one socks in twenty drawers must double up somewhere, the twenty-to-the-hundredth sequences a hundred-residue protein could have, against which every protein that exists is a vanishing fraction, the four billion addresses of a thirty-two-bit space read as a population before any block is routed; the carrier is the bound itself, a product of a base and an exponent or a constraint the world is believed to obey; it makes countable the maximum, and the fraction held is exact, since the numerator is the list and the denominator is a formula; it silently excludes whatever the bound's model did not admit, and it counts as members whatever the model admits and the world does not, so the address space counts unrouted blocks as places while the model's premise, that every address is a place, was never a fact, and the sequence space counts chains no cell could fold; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count is round in some base and the enumerator cannot point to a member it did not itself find, since a found universe is a roster and a bound is a number, and the enumerator who says a list is one thousandth complete against a wall has said only how big the wall is; analytical, with the chess estimate and the address bound as observed cases; the sixty-four codons are a wall only until the table is written, after which every codon is derived and the universe is Compiler's catalogue, which is the passage between the first two stops of the walk; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which asks whether the list can name its universe and the fraction held, the case where the fraction is exact and the universe is empty of members; not Zwicky's box, where the cells are coordinates a member can be placed at, since here there are no cells, only a count.

seed: Denominator promotion: the moment an enumerator writes a count out into a roster, a wall becomes a grammar, a corpus becomes a frame, a curve becomes an estimate, a shuffle becomes a set of named twins, and each promotion changes which exclusions are silent and which become visible. The map holds the stops; the passages between adjacent stops, which the Round wall → Compiler's catalogue case exposes, are a second map: what each promotion costs, what it makes nameable, and the tell that an enumerator promoted a denominator to look found.
